# Next-Gen ERP Solutions

> Next-Gen ERP Solutions is an SAP training institute in Hyderabad offering instructor-led courses, practical projects, SAP server access, certification guidance, career mentoring, and placement support.

The website serves freshers, experienced professionals, and career-gap candidates exploring SAP careers. Use the pages below for current public information about courses, training pathways, placement support, and institute contact details.

## Primary Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.next-generpsolutions.com/): Overview of SAP training, learning pathways, courses, trainers, and placement support.
- [About the Institute](https://www.next-generpsolutions.com/about): Training approach, mission, and institute information.
- [SAP Courses](https://www.next-generpsolutions.com/courses): Complete catalogue of available SAP courses.
- [Placement Support](https://www.next-generpsolutions.com/placements): Placement process, career preparation, and hiring support.
- [Career Journeys](https://www.next-generpsolutions.com/career-journeys): Learning pathways for freshers, working professionals, and career-gap candidates.
- [Student Success Stories](https://www.next-generpsolutions.com/success-stories): Published student career outcomes and transformation stories.
- [SAP Career Blog](https://www.next-generpsolutions.com/blog): SAP career guidance, interview preparation, and industry insights.
- [Contact](https://www.next-generpsolutions.com/contact): Demo booking, counselling, address, phone, and enquiry information.

## Featured SAP Courses

- [SAP FICO Training](https://www.next-generpsolutions.com/courses/sap-fico): Financial Accounting and Controlling training.
- [SAP MM Training](https://www.next-generpsolutions.com/courses/sap-mm): Materials Management and procurement training.
- [SAP SD Training](https://www.next-generpsolutions.com/courses/sap-sd): Sales and Distribution training.
- [SAP ABAP Training](https://www.next-generpsolutions.com/courses/sap-abap): SAP application development training.
- [SAP BASIS Training](https://www.next-generpsolutions.com/courses/sap-basis): SAP system administration training.
- [SAP HCM Training](https://www.next-generpsolutions.com/courses/sap-hcm): Human Capital Management training.
- [SAP SuccessFactors Training](https://www.next-generpsolutions.com/courses/sap-successfactors): Cloud human-experience management training.
